copy.curiosityHook: Can a stubborn detective stay on the trail of a dangerous killer while babysitting a pampered action hero determined to mimic his every move?
copy.description: Aiming to land a gritty role on a new show, Hollywood star Nick Lang tags along with New York detective John Moss, whose hunt for a serial killer is derailed by the actor's endless questions and imitation.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, funny, and exciting 90s action-comedy energy that pairs high-momentum crime thrills with breezy banter.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Badham, this fast-moving 1991 buddy-cop comedy mines sharp laughs and exciting momentum from the clash between movie star ego and relentless street detective work.

allowedMaterial: Nick Lang's deal to shadow detective John Moss for acting research
Moss's active pursuit of a serial killer
Comedic friction from Nick mimicking and bothering Moss
excludedMaterial: Identity or fate of the serial killer
